d: When Holly proposes to Phil, he admits he needs closure with an ex. Heartbroken, she confides in sleigh driver Jake, who offers unexpected comfort. Is Phil her true love, or is Jake the Christmas miracle she's been waiting for?

Darcy Archer is a romantic, she dreams of being swept off her feet by the perfect man. Instead, she accidentally crashes into a handsome, sharply dressed stranger walking his dog. He is knocked unconscious and taken to hospital, leaving his puppy and a mysterious Christmas gift behind.

Interior designer Leslie Major loves all things Christmas. When she meets handsome Edmund James, she quickly learns he thinks the festivities are frivolous and superficial. Determined to change his mind, Leslie works her Christmas magic on him, and the unlikely couple fall in love along the way.

Traumatized by her past, Christmas is not at the top of cynical journalist Sarah's list this time of year. However, waltzing through life's unexpected emergencies and forced to return to her small-town home where she bumps into her ex,  she is taught the Christmas Dance.

As a last wish, a recently hospitalized grandmother tasks her daughter Michelle and granddaughter Sara with a list of festive accomplishments to do together before Christmas, hoping that the adventure of the experience will repair their relationship.
